title: Taskflow Agent finds search-parameter XSS in mkdocs-material
summary: A crafted search query can reach an unescaped innerHTML write in the search-suggestion component, enabling JavaScript execution in the documentation site origin when that feature is enabled.
ai_role: GHSL credits its Taskflow Agent with discovery and says Peter Stöckli manually verified the issue. The advisory says the flaw existed from v7.2.0 through v9.7.6.
classification_note: The public GHSL advisory documents the XSS and remediation; it does not claim exploitation in the wild.
remediation_note: GHSL’s timeline says the fix was released with the advisory on 2026-07-19; the GHSL public write-up is dated 2026-10-22. It describes versions through 9.7.6 as affected but does not name a fixed release number.
